title: Naming by the longest chain
caption: 4-methylpentan-2-ol: the longest chain holding the –OH has five carbons (pent-), numbered from the end nearer the OH so it gets 2; a methyl branch sits on carbon 4.
alt: Skeletal formula of 4-methylpentan-2-ol with the hydroxyl group highlighted.
description: A five-carbon zigzag with OH on carbon 2 and a methyl branch on carbon 4.
Numbered from the OH end: OH at 2, methyl at 4.

panels.label: 4-methylpentan-2-ol
panels.sub: chain of 5, OH on C2, CH₃ on C4

note: Number from the end that gives the main group the lowest number.
